prompt:

Create ONE finished square Swedish vocabulary artwork for an adult mobile flashcard app. Use the Finnish iOS card style: vivid tactile realistic editorial illustration, memorable scale and clear action, warm light, cream header with fine gold edging, bold navy typography, integrated cream/gold memory-link caption, pale blue bottom example strip. Generous margins, phone-legible text. No watermark, logo, app chrome, contact sheet, or unsupplied paragraphs. Sound/spelling associations are memory aids, never pronunciation or etymological claims.
Header text verbatim: "helig". Smaller English meaning verbatim: "holy".
Scene: Visitors quietly treating an old place of worship with respect, warm light and no specific religious claim.
Memory-link caption verbatim: "helig resembles holy.".
Swedish example in bottom strip verbatim: "Platsen är helig för många människor.".
Teach only the sense shown by this sentence. Print only the supplied heading, English meaning, memory caption and Swedish example. If the caption contains a sound/spelling association, mark it with the small exact label "Memory trick".
